# Mapping Africa — 2021

> Benchmark chips for Africa (Mapping Africa sites) cut from the 2021 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection lacuna.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/lacuna_2021_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/lacuna_2021_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/lacuna_2021_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lacuna_2021/items.parquet)
